title: Concept: OS command executed from a runtime string in clojure — review required
description: In clojure, a shell command is built as a string. The shell re-parses it, so any metacharacter in an interpolated value starts a new command. The vector form of the same function avoids the shell entirely and removes the class of bug.
applicability: clojure services and tooling that invoke external programs.
risk: Shell injection with application privileges; HIGH severity.
